changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A pull request's checkout fingerprint is now its commit pair alone (SourceFingerprint.git of head:base). Each recorded capture of a pull request or pull request review gets that fingerprint from the version its review pinned, so a result recorded before the change is not read as changed work. A pull request capture without a commit pair loses its tree key instead.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_practice rp SET capture_decision = jsonb_set( rp.capture_decision, '{sourceFingerprints,scm.repository.tree}', to_jsonb(encode(sha256( convert_to('2', 'UTF8') || '\x00'::bytea || convert_to('scm.repository.tree', 'UTF8') || '\x00'::bytea || convert_to(split_part(r.item_version, ':', 4) || ':' || split_part(r.item_version, ':', 3), 'UTF8')), 'hex'))) FROM review r WHERE r.id = rp.review_id AND r.workspace_id = rp.workspace_id AND rp.capture_decision -> 'sourceFingerprints' ->> 'scm.repository.tree' IS NOT NULL AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 1) IN ('scm.pull_request', 'scm.pull_request_review') AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 2) = 'v1' AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 3) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$' AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 4) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$'; -- A pull request capture whose version names no commit pair cannot get the new fingerprint. Its diff and record -- fingerprints still bind its commits, so the tree key goes rather than read as a change. UPDATE review_practice rp SET capture_decision = rp.capture_decision #- '{sourceFingerprints,scm.repository.tree}' FROM review r WHERE r.id = rp.review_id AND r.workspace_id = rp.workspace_id AND rp.capture_decision -> 'sourceFingerprints' ->> 'scm.repository.tree' IS NOT NULL AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 1) IN ('scm.pull_request', 'scm.pull_request_review') AND NOT (split_part(r.item_version, ':', 2) = 'v1' AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 3) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$' AND split_part(r.item_version, ':', 4) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$');
